title: Deferred promote conductor with session-fencing, simulated-smoke and rewind hooks
author: Maya Rodriguez
description: Motivation: introduce a 'deferred promote' release conductor to safely progress shadowed model variants into active canaries by combining session-fencing, affinity locks, and a lightweight simulated-smoke validation before live traffic promotion. Many incidents we investigated showed regressions only after small stateful cohorts were promoted; this PR aims to provide deterministic rehearsal and a rewind hook to safely abort and restore previous model state. Changes implement the conductor, an in-cluster simulated-smoke runner, an affinity/session fencing layer to ensure cohort consistency during promote/rewind, and operator-friendly runbook docs. Key behaviors: 1) when a shadow cohort meets signal thresholds it enters 'deferred-promote' and is fenced to a cohort lease; 2) synthetic-smoke jobs run in parallel with mirrored traffic to validate stateful interactions (DB writes, session affinity, KV cache warmup); 3) if synthetic checks pass and telemetry gates are green, a timeboxed promote proceeds; 4) on failure or manual abort the conductor triggers a rewind hook that replays recent traffic against a snapshot and rebinds session leases to the previous model; 5) operator-visible playbook, metrics and trace annotations are emitted at every step. Checklist: [x] rollout controller implementation; [x] simulated-smoke harness and lightweight replay runner; [x] session/affinity lease primitives; [x] telemetry gates and SLO-based abort credit; [x] unit + integration + e2e scenarios in CI; [x] runbook and console UX updates. Testing: unit tests for lease logic and state transitions; integration tests that exercise promote -> rewind paths using the replay harness; e2e smoke in staging with a small synthetic cohort. Rollout plan: merge to main guarded by ci; enable feature flag rollout.conductor.deferred_promote=false by default; enable for internal orgs and run simulated smoke at 2% of traffic for first 48 hours; promote to full when 72h stable. Related: ENG-4821 (rollout regressions post-shadow traffic).

release_notes: Introduces deferred-promote conductor: session-fencing and cohort leases; simulated-smoke replay harness to validate stateful interactions before canary promotion; rewind hook that replays traffic and restores previous model when abort conditions are met; operator runbook and console UX for managing deferred promotes.
